**Lumina 1.2.3 — Always-On Display Lockscreen**

* UltraLight typography ambient clock on locked display
* Smooth alpha cross-dissolve animation into stock lockscreen
* Sub-0.1% CPU consumption to maximize iPhone 5s battery life
* PreferenceLoader settings bundle in Settings > Lumina
* Strict Pure GNU Tar format (resolves corrupted filesystem tarfile error)

**Compatibility:** iPhone 5s (Apple A7 arm64), iOS 12.0 – 12.5.8.
**Architecture:** Rootful Sileo / Zebra / Cydia APT.
